steps.npc: What are you doing up here? Only the palace guards are allowed up here.

options.text: I am one of the palace guards.

steps.player: I am one of the palace guards.

steps.npc: No, you're not! I know all the palace guards.
I interview all the new recruits. I'd know if you were one of them.

steps.player: That blows that story out of the water then.

steps.npc: What sort of surgery is that? I've never heard of it. Besides, you look reasonably healthy.
Why is this relevant anyway? You still shouldn't be here.

steps.player: What about the King? Surely you'd let him up here.

steps.npc: Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
Anyway, you're not the King either. So get out of my sight.

options.text: Yes I know, but this is important.

steps.player: Yes, I know, but this is important.

steps.npc: Ok, I'm listening. Tell me what's so important.
Well it can't be that important then.

options.text: The castle has just received its ale delivery.

steps.player: The castle has just received its ale delivery.

steps.npc: Now that is important. However I'm the wrong person to speak to about it. Go talk to the kitchen staff.
